property_summary: For every caller and block timestamp, a call to fallback with msg.value == 10 ether succeeds on the reference contract (updates pastBlockTime and does not revert), while the mutant requiring 9 ether will reject such a call (revert) for at least some inputs, so testing that a fallback call with 10 ether does not revert is a universal property the reference satisfies and the mutant violates for those inputs.
change_summary: Change the required incoming value from 10 ether to 9 ether, altering when the fallback accepts and thus when pastBlockTime and potential transfer change.
